explication: html-ppt is an AgentSkill and static HTML/CSS/JS toolkit for authoring presentation decks. The documented workflow is an authoring agent using the skill and deck templates, with themes, layouts, and animations shaping browser-rendered slides; presenter mode adds synchronized previews, speaker notes, and a timer. The README documents these capabilities, but no source excerpts were supplied, so implementation-level call relationships are not inferred.
